title: First Weil-map square for the explicit powered geometric pullback
statement: For finite fields k0 and k1 and a prime l invertible in both, let X/k0 and C/k1 be schemes and v: Cbar -> Xbar satisfy Fr_C v = v Fr_X^r, for r >= 0. If G is a constructible source Weil sheaf [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] and P its explicit powered geometric pullback [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback], the canonical carrier identification theta: v^*G -> P(G) intertwines the first structure map of P(G) with the r-fold source structure map [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]: Fr_C^*(theta);phi_P = upperStarCompIso(hv);v^*(phi_G,r);theta. The carrier identification is the forgetful image of eqToIso of the existing poweredGeometricPullback_obj_carrier equality, in its inverse direction.

source.place: Paragraphs 1--3: local Frobenius under finite constant extension and restriction; the iterated Weil map groups into blocks of length r.

proof.text: Compute mapOfNatIso on an algebra with specified carrier and structure isomorphism, retaining its output algebra and carrier equality as parameters. The explicit powered pullback is this construction with the r-fold source Weil map: use defining equalities of functors and of their object values to identify it without unfolding concrete pullback functors beneath object maps. This gives the first adic structure square for the original canonical carrier identification. Forget the adic exchange using the forget-coherence API and an abstract sheaf functor. Its initial inverse upperStarIsoLowerStarInv cancels the comparison in frobeniusStr, and its final comparison combines with the source Weil map to give frobeniusPowStr r. This proves the first square, including r=0.

theorem poweredGeometricPullback_firstStructure (G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X) :
    @Eq ((((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom)^*[_]).obj
      ((v)^*[WeilCoefficients.{u} l].obj G.obj.carrier.X) ⟶
        ((poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj G).obj.carrier.X)
      (((C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom)^*[_].map
          (X := (v)^*[WeilCoefficients.{u} l].obj G.obj.carrier.X)
          ((ProEtale.AdicSheaf.forget _).map
            (eqToIso (poweredGeometricPullback_obj_carrier v r hv G).symm).hom) ≫
        ((poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj G).frobeniusStr)
      ((ProEtale.upperStarCompIso _ hv).hom.app G.obj.carrier.X ≫
        @CategoryStruct.comp _ _
          ((v)^*[_].obj ((((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom)^*[_].obj
            G.obj.carrier.X)) ((v)^*[_].obj G.obj.carrier.X)
          ((poweredGeometricPullback v r hv).obj G).obj.carrier.X
          ((v)^*[_].map (G.frobeniusPowStr r))
          ((ProEtale.AdicSheaf.forget _).map
            (eqToIso (poweredGeometricPullback_obj_carrier v r hv G).symm).hom))
